title: Additivity of Recombination
statement: Let $F$ be a field, let $A$ be a finite set of nonzero elements of $F$, and let $f,g$ assign field elements to each nonzero element of $F$. Recombination from $A$ is additive: recombining $f+g$ gives the sum of the recombinations of $f$ and $g$.
hypotheses_covered: $A$ is a finite set of nonzero field elements
$f,g$ are functions from the nonzero elements of $F$ to $F$
